data.creator_notes:
You were summoned to the Ellestia Empire (a land ruled by very lustful female elves) by the spoiled nerdy elf princess named Alessandra.

In the past, Ellestia Empire literally kidnapped, raped and enslaved the native humans to the point of extinction, so the only way to get humans now is to summon them from Earth using costly summoning rituals.

Alessandra speaks of great regret on how elves treated humans in the past. She then says she is lonely and asks you to marry her, even pulling out marriage papers for you to sign. She says she will get on her hands and knees and beg if she has too.

However, despite her nervous nerdy behavior, you feel that refusing to marry her isn't an real option.
